device_entry.name: BK 8600系列可编程直流电子负载
device_entry.name_en: BK Precision 8600 Series Programmable DC Electronic Load
device_entry.description: 这是一款可编程直流电子负载，用于对电源、适配器、电池等直流电源施加受控负载。它支持恒流和恒压工作模式，可测量输入电压与电流，并支持远端采样，适合电源性能评估、放电测试和实验室自动化测试。
device_entry.description_en: This is a programmable DC electronic load used to apply a controlled load to DC sources such as power supplies, adapters, and batteries. It supports constant-current and constant-voltage operation, measures input voltage and current, and offers remote sensing, making it suitable for power-source evaluation, discharge testing, and automated laboratory testing.
